author: HikerPlayz
body:
Username- HikerPlayz
Reason- Evading Ban (_Crazy8Playz_)
Reason to be unbanned- Just because I play on a public computer sometimes, doesn't mean its the same person. The IP might be the same but the person is different. I have No idea who _Crazy8Playz_ is but that is not me. I'd appreciate it if you lifted my ban as it is unfair.

And where is the proof that it's the same person? Its an assumption which makes it inaccurate. This is my first ban on this server and I would like it to go back to 0 bans.

Thank you,\
HikerPlayz

replies.body: I'll give you the benefit of the doubt, as this appeal seems to prove that you aren't really a suspect of evading. Try to still keep alert of what networks you log into, and if you have any public VPNs, I'd advise to not use them.
